2. Cancellation Policy
If cancellation is unavoidable, please review the terms below carefully.
Alternative Options (Subject to Availability)
Before cancelling completely, please consider these options:
Reschedule: Change your date for a fee of IDR 1,000,000 per participant.
Voucher: Receive a voucher equal to the deposit value for future use.
Insurance Letter: We provide official documents to support your travel insurance claim.
⚠️ Important Refund Rules:
• Park fees are strictly non-refundable non-reschedulable under any circumstances.
• Missed dives due to seasickness, fatigue, illness, late arrival, or personal choice are non-refundable.
• If Komodo National Park or Indonesian authorities decide to close access to the park (weather, regulation, quota limits, force majeure), no refund will be possible as this is beyond our control.
😊 We always aim to find reasonable solutions when possible.
A respectful conversation and a smile often help us explore alternatives together.
